prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 49.3 °C (59% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 54.3 °C (51% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 55.8 °C (43% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.71 s (5% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.25 l/min (5% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 388 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.2 % (6% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
